summary.text: Ryan McDougle is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 26, serving since 2006.
The district covers all of Gloucester, Mathews and New Kent counties and parts of Hanover, James City and King and Queen counties.
Ryan McDougle served in the House from 2002 to 2006, and the Senate profile lists Ryan McDougle as Senate Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Ryan McDougle was born in Hanover, Virginia.
It lists a B.S. in Political Science and History from James Madison University and a J.D. from the Marshall-Wythe School of Law at the College of William and Mary.
The biography lists Ryan McDougle's occupation as attorney.
The memberships entry lists Republican Caucus Chairman, Chairman of the Rules Committee, Chairman of the Finance Subcommittee on Public Safety, and Vice-Chairman of the Courts of Justice Committee.
Ryan McDougle serves on the Commerce and Labor; Courts of Justice; Finance and Appropriations; Rehabilitation and Social Services; and Rules committees.
